logger.doc:name: Log RAW request
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- '[ollama-worker] RAW taskId=' ++ (attributes.properties.taskId default 'unknown') ++ ' payload=' ++ write(payload, 'application/json')]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- if (isEmpty(attributes.properties.publishedAt)) -1 else ((now() as Number {unit: "milliseconds"}) - (attributes.properties.publishedAt as Number)) / 1000

logger.doc:name: Log SKIP stale request
logger.message: #['[ollama-worker] SKIP taskId=' ++ vars.taskId ++ ' ageSeconds=' ++ (vars.requestAgeSeconds as String) ++ ' (gateway already timed out)']

logger.doc:name: Log Ollama REQUEST
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- '[ollama-worker] REQUEST taskId=' ++ vars.taskId ++ ' payload=' ++ write(payload, 'application/json')]

ee:transform.doc:name: Reshape native Ollama response to OpenAI format

logger.doc:name: Log Ollama RESPONSE
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- '[ollama-worker] RESPONSE taskId=' ++ vars.taskId ++ ' payload=' ++ write(payload, 'application/json')]

logger.doc:name: Log Ollama ERROR
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- '[ollama-worker] ERROR taskId=' ++ (vars.taskId default 'unknown') ++ ' errorType=' ++ (error.errorType.namespace default '') ++ ':' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default '') ++ ' message=' ++ (error.description default '')]
